verdict:
The map is mostly complete against both books. Every Brilakis Part A-D heading and every Oxford chapter heading has a topic. The real gaps are three: large-bore access bailout, CT planning for PCI and CTO, and a scope bucket for the 13 unmatched peripheral, aortic and venous videos.

The coverage ratings are too generous in places. Ten corrections leave 28 topics rated covered. HaemoLab is a waveform and calculation trainer, not a catheter-handling lab, so RHC, LHC and AS should be partial. Impella and ECMO management lack purge and weaning practice. GP IIb/IIIa or cangrelor cannot be given in the UI, and the TAVI lab has no coronary access. In the other direction, team closed-loop scoring, the 12-lead ECG and bench POT earn partial credit.

Notes for the build plan:
(1) The fluoroscopic PCI lab (src/ui/sections/AngioPci.tsx) has only 4 scenarios: lad-focal, rca-calcified, lcx-stemi and rca-cto. There is no bifurcation, left main, ostial, graft or ISR case, so those P1 and P2 topics stay text-only or bench-only.
(2) Many P1 gaps are cheap wins. src/simulation/angioPci.ts already implements setExtension, setBuddyWire, seatGuide, shapeTip, covered-stent devices, the coil and aspiration-thrombectomy bailouts, the gp2b3a and ic-nitroprusside drugs, IVUS (loadIvus/ivusAt) and the pressure wire (recordPressure/samplePullback). None of these is imported into AngioPci.tsx, and pciDrugFor maps only heparin, protamine, atropine and IC adenosine, verapamil and adrenaline. Connecting them would lift pci-guide-extension, pci-support-escalation, pci-wire-shaping, comp-covered-stent, comp-distal-perf, cx-aspiration and ph-iv-antiplatelet.
(3) phy-ffr-nhpr wrongly lists 'PCI in the cath lab' as a current lab. The rating stays covered on the strength of PhysiologyLab.
(4) The anomalous-sinus anatomy variants (anomalous-rca-left-sinus, anomalous-lcx-right-sinus) are built in src/simulation/anatomy.ts and render/xray/coronaryGrowth.ts but are absent from simulation/caseGenerator.ts. dx-coronary-anomalies is therefore correctly text-only, but cheap to promote.
(5) The video statistics are inflated. cto-hybrid holds 336 videos and should be split into the specific CTO topics. The same Sensei podcast episodes are counted in both pro-mentorship-teaching (154) and pro-career (160). Those three topics hold about 60% of the 1,062 matched videos.
